facts.text: NIA may seek trial in absentia under Section 356, BNSS 2023

facts.text: Applies only to: proclaimed offender under Section 84 BNSS — offence punishable with 10 years+, life or death

pages.title: Bar Associations cannot refuse to represent an accused

facts.text: Faizabad/Ayodhya Bar Association resolved not to represent accused in alleged Ayodhya Ram Temple funds embezzlement case
facts.head: What happened

facts.text: Legal position: such resolutions are illegal, unconstitutional, null and void
facts.head: What happened

facts.text: Article: 22(1); Provision: Arrested person's right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of choice
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Article: 21; Provision: Fair trial part of right to life
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Article: 14; Provision: Equality before law
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Article: 39A; Provision: Equal justice and free legal aid (DPSP)
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Case: A.S. Mohammed Rafi v. State of Tamil Nadu (2010); Holding: SC — boycott resolutions wholly illegal, null and void (Coimbatore police case)
facts.head: Cases

facts.text: Case: Kuldeep Agarwal v. State of Uttarakhand (2019); Holding: Uttarakhand HC — "special circumstances" refusal is for individual advocate, not Bar
facts.head: Cases

facts.text: Case: Karnataka HC (2020); Holding: Obstruction of lawyers for Kashmiri students may be contempt
facts.head: Cases

facts.text: Case: Madras HC (2025); Holding: Bar is not a trade union
facts.head: Cases

facts.head: Cases
